personality.description: This person is imaginative and curious, often jumping toward new ideas, unusual angles, or creative possibilities, but they may also be scattered and inconsistent in follow-through. They tend to be socially energized, speaking readily with enthusiasm and drawing others into conversation, while still being considerate and eager to keep interactions harmonious. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually respond with strong empathy and a desire to protect everyone’s feelings, yet they may feel anxious, overthink the situation, and hesitate if any option risks conflict or disappointment. In group discussions, they are likely to be warm, expressive, and idea-rich, but they may drift off topic, react emotionally to tension, and struggle to stay organized or decisive.
